title: Five Framework-Level Kill Conditions
claim: The framework declares five kill conditions, any one of which would collapse the structure: (1) Grace kill: exhibit sustained local moral improvement with no external input. (2) Cross-uniqueness kill: show justice and mercy require a trade-off with no simultaneous maximum. (3) Moral conservation kill: find a moral event whose ledger closes with no invisible remainder. (4) Shannon kill: show bandwidth/signal/noise fails to apply to a moral channel. (5) Trinity kill: show the triadic-coupled equilibrium system can be reproduced by n≠3.
assumptions: The canonical Master Equation document (Aug 9, 2026) declares these as the integrity backbone
definitions: Grace kill: closed system reducing its own S_m
Moral conservation kill: ledger closing without invisible remainder
Shannon kill: bandwidth/signal/noise inapplicable to moral channel
Trinity kill: non-triadic coupling reproducing the equilibrium
negative_guards: These are framework-level kills, not per-law kills. Each law has additional kill conditions in §7.
A kill condition firing is a successful test result, not a failure of the testing system.
kill_conditions: Any of the five conditions is met with rigorous evidence.

ledger.meaning: Created during three-model audit (Claude/o3/DeepSeek) of canonical doc vs atom ledger.
ledger.limits: Seed status is not additional evidence.
